name: Fluent azul
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity, exceptionally polished desktop application design concept for the existing Portuguese Windows technical support app "Suporte TI Gráfico". This is a serious current-generation desktop productivity and PC diagnostic app, designed by a senior product designer. Wide landscape 16:10 composition, front-facing full application window, completely visible including native-style top title bar, a small distinctive blue computer/diagnostic app icon immediately beside the title, and Windows minimize/maximize/close controls. No monitor hardware, no browser URL bar, no external backdrop, no tilted perspective, no marketing headlines. Generous but efficient spacing, excellent hierarchy, very crisp readable Portuguese UI typography, realistic implementable design, not generic wireframes or an old WinForms form. Preserve the blue identity and generic use; no UCDB, organization branding, account avatars, AI chatbot, subscriptions, or unrelated business statistics.

Consistent content across all five concepts: left navigation with elegant consistent vector icons and names "Visão geral", "Hardware", "Rede", "Windows", "Impressão", "Contas e políticas", "Relatórios"; settings at bottom. Main page title "Painel de diagnóstico", small subtitle "Informações do computador e ferramentas de suporte". Top context tabs "Resumo", "Desempenho", "Conectividade". Search placeholder "Buscar ferramenta…". Main dashboard contains beautiful CPU and memory time-series visualizations with visible axes and actual-looking data points, subtle gradient area fills, thin refined grid, useful legends, 0–100% vertical scale and time labels. Large metrics: "CPU" "24%" and "Memória RAM" "58%" "9,3 GB de 16 GB". Clearly differentiated blue CPU and teal RAM. Network results are two EQUALLY emphasized metrics "Download" "465,9 Mbps" and "Upload" "40,7 Mbps" with a small "Latência 18 ms", plus the button "Testar conexão". Optional compact disk occupancy card "Disco C:" "62% ocupado". Bottom action area "Consultar computador", "Salvar log", "Copiar resultado". State text "Monitor ao vivo · 1 amostra/s". One short helper description associated with the tool, not paragraphs everywhere. Small clearly legible footer "Conceito visual · dados ilustrativos". Every datum is only conceptual. Do not add false green system-health checkmarks. Aesthetic must feel genuinely premium, contemporary, confident and visually engaging, while remaining legible, accessible and useful.
VISUAL DIRECTION 1: Fluent blue Windows 11 premium native desktop. Deep midnight navy #0B1220, slightly lighter layered cards #142033, blue accent #5EA3FF, soft teal #3DD6C6. Integrated refined title bar and left sidebar, subtle Mica-style atmosphere confined to chrome, solid clean content surfaces. Selected navigation item has a thin blue pill indicator and subtle blue tinted background, not a giant saturated rectangle. 12px rounded cards, refined hairline borders, restrained shallow shadows. Use a beautifully balanced two-column dashboard: CPU and RAM graph cards side by side at the center, paired bandwidth results below, compact upper summary row. Text Segoe UI Variable-like, medium/semibold titles, large tabular numbers. Make the navigation and segmented tabs feel softly animated via elegant active indicators, but render a perfectly sharp static view. No arrows explaining animation. Label discreetly at top right "Proposta 01 · Fluent azul".
